clue.text: Trace letter about inhabitant of the dump

indicators.note: about means the letter's name goes round the other piece, holding it inside

parts.note: VEE is the spelt-out name of the letter V
Stig of the Dump is a children's novel whose title character lives in a chalk-pit rubbish tip

explanation.surface: A trace of a letter found on a rubbish dump.
explanation.walkthrough: Stig of the Dump is a British children's classic by Clive King, about a cave boy living in a chalk-pit tip; 'about' wraps the letter's name round him.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestige is a small remaining sign or trace of something that once existed.

clue.text: Cut up about ear-related fancy goods

indicators.note: about means the turned word wraps round the other piece
in a down clue, up means this word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: to axe something is to cut it
OTIC is the adjective for things to do with the ear

explanation.surface: Someone cuts up over a display of fancy ear-shaped goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the word for cut into EXA, since this is a down clue, and 'about' wraps that round the ear adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Exotica are unusual, foreign or showy items, so fancy goods describes them well.

clue.text: Performer of no account in "Hair"

indicators.note: of no means the abbreviation that follows is taken away from the performer

parts.note: an actress is a female performer

explanation.surface: An unknown performer in the musical Hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Of no account' looks like the idiom for unimportant; read literally it says remove AC from ACTRESS. The quotes round Hair point at the stage musical, but the definition is just hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress is a long lock of a person's hair.

clue.text: Postage fixed by the police

indicators.note: fixed in the sense of rigged or rearranged, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: The price of a stamp has been fixed by the police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixed' rearranges the letters of POSTAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gestapo was the secret state police force of Nazi Germany.

clue.text: Insect — call it Eric, initially

parts.note: to term something is to call it by a name

indicators.note: initially means only the opening letter of the name is used

explanation.surface: Someone names their pet insect Eric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes the E of Eric.
explanation.definitionFit: Termites are social insects that feed on wood, often called white ants.

clue.text: Quarter permitted to draw out

parts.note: E, east, is one of the four compass quarters
licit means lawful or allowed

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood allowed to draw something out of people.
explanation.definitionFit: To elicit is to draw out a response or information from someone.

clue.text: Memorials bringing a Parisian round in seconds

indicators.note: in means the turned word goes inside the other piece

parts.note: seconds and moments are both brief stretches of time

indicators.note: round means the French word is turned about, read backwards

parts.note: UN is French for a, as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: Memorials that bring a Parisian round in a few seconds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' turns the French article backwards and 'in' places it within the seconds. Acts and Monuments was John Foxe's book, tying this to 10 and 27 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Monuments are structures put up to commemorate people or events, which is what memorials are.

clue.text: Salt can one supplies a composer

parts.note: a tar or salt is an old word for a sailor
a tin is a can
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A sailor's tin of something supplies a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salt' looks like the seasoning; it is a sailor, as is TAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Giuseppe Tartini was an Italian Baroque violinist and composer, known for the Devil's Trill sonata.

clue.text: Spoil Alpine region with love, getting sense of 10, for example

parts.note: to mar is to spoil
the Tyrol is a region of the Alps in Austria and Italy
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O
the gist of something is its sense or meaning

explanation.surface: Someone ruins an Alpine region romantically while trying to make sense of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 across is John Foxe, whose Book of Martyrs chronicled Protestant martyrs.
explanation.definitionFit: A martyrologist writes histories of martyrs; Foxe is the most famous English example.

clue.text: Author of 27 and 7 of the Church, one in opposition carrying cross

definitions.text: Author of 27 and 7 of the Church

indicators.note: carrying means the opponent holds the cross inside

parts.note: a foe is someone who opposes you
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A church author, opposed to someone, carries a cross.
explanation.walkthrough: Answers 27 and 7 give Acts and Monuments of the Church, the full title of John Foxe's Book of Martyrs.
explanation.definitionFit: John Foxe wrote Acts and Monuments, the sixteenth-century history of Protestant martyrs.

clue.text: Still return thanks to island king in hovel

indicators.note: in means these pieces sit inside the hovel

parts.note: a sty is a filthy dwelling, a hovel

indicators.note: return means the word for thanks is read backwards

parts.note: TA is British informal for thanks
Iona is an island of the Inner Hebrides
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king living in a hovel on an island still sends his thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns the British thanks word backwards, giving AT; 'in' puts the run AT, island and king inside the hovel.
explanation.definitionFit: Stationary means not moving, standing still.

clue.text: Farrow's mum's noxious emission

parts.note: Mia Farrow is an American actress, so Farrow's gives her first name with s
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: An actress's mother lets off something nasty.
explanation.definitionFit: A miasma is an unpleasant or unhealthy vapour, once blamed for spreading disease.

clue.text: Co-ruler sending semi-victorious 6 to the river

indicators.note: semi- means half, so only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: triumphant means victorious
VI is the Roman numeral for six

explanation.surface: A co-ruler sends half-victorious troops off to the river.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' looks like a cross-reference to 6 down, but it is just the number, VI.
explanation.definitionFit: A triumvir was one of three men sharing power in ancient Rome.

clue.text: - meals provided control panel

parts.note: the printed mark is a dash
board means meals supplied, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A control panel comes with meals included.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue opens with a printed dash, which gives its own name.
explanation.definitionFit: A dashboard is the panel of instruments and controls in front of a driver.

clue.text: Welcome fellow catching a song of the mountains

parts.note: hi is a greeting, a welcome

indicators.note: catching means the man holds the other pieces inside

parts.note: a man is a fellow
a lay is a song or ballad

explanation.surface: A friendly greeting from a man who catches a mountain song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'catching' places A and the song within the fellow; the greeting goes in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Himalayan describes the Himalayas, the great Asian mountain range.

clue.text: One moving house in no hurry

definitions.text: One moving house in no hurry

parts.words: One moving house in no hurry
parts.note: reads as a leisurely removal; really a creature carrying its shell-home as it slowly crawls along

explanation.definitionFit: A snail carries its shell as a home and is proverbially slow.

clue.text: Capacious man is out of order

indicators.note: is out of means the man stands outside, round the order

parts.note: Roy is a man's name
OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: A large man finds things out of order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of order' looks like an anagram signal or 'broken'; read as 'man is outside order', 'is out of' puts the man round the order.
explanation.definitionFit: Roomy means having plenty of space, the same as capacious.

clue.text: Performing in opera outdoors

indicators.note: performing suggests the letters are put through their paces in a new order

explanation.surface: A singer performs in an outdoor opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Performing' rearranges IN OPERA.
explanation.definitionFit: Open air means outside, out of doors.

clue.text: Mineral in flower after a party

indicators.note: after means the flower comes behind the other pieces

parts.note: Lab is short for the British Labour Party
the aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: A mineral turns up in a flower bed after a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a fine translucent mineral, a form of gypsum used for carving.

clue.text: Kingsley's performing — that's a blessing

parts.note: Ben Kingsley is a British actor; this gives his first name
the 's stands for is
on stage, performing, is on

explanation.surface: Kingsley is performing, and that is a blessing.
explanation.walkthrough: Kingsley Amis comes to mind first, but it is the actor Ben Kingsley.
explanation.definitionFit: A benison is an old word for a blessing or benediction.

clue.text: One opting for introduction to economics reader

indicators.note: introduction to means only the opening letter of the word is taken

parts.note: a lector is a reader, in church or a university

explanation.surface: Someone choosing an introductory economics reader.
explanation.definitionFit: An elector is a voter, one who chooses between candidates.

clue.text: Stick out, keeping girl hot for another

indicators.note: keeping means the word holds the girl's name inside

parts.note: to jut is to stick out
Di is a girl's name
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone sticks out, keeping one girl in the heat for another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another girl, following 'girl' earlier in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Judith is a female name, so it is another girl alongside Di.

clue.text: Sufficiently matured in spring, though lacking majority

parts.note: a well is a spring of water
a hung parliament is one where no party has a majority

explanation.surface: Something matured in spring, even without a majority.
explanation.walkthrough: Game is hung to mature; well hung meat has hung long enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat or game that is well hung has been left hanging long enough to develop flavour.

clue.text: He's mad as he goes a-Maying

definitions.meaning: an insane man, in slang a crackpot
the rhyme 'here we go gathering nuts in May' makes him one gathering nuts

explanation.definitionFit: A nutter is slang for a mad person, and literally one who collects nuts.

clue.text: What to do to one in college?

definitions.text: What to do to one in college?

indicators.note: in means the letter for one goes inside the college

parts.note: a tech is a technical college
A is the indefinite article, one

explanation.surface: A question about what to do with a student at college.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and builds: A in TECH.
explanation.definitionFit: Teaching is what staff do to a student in a college.

clue.text: Is astir, say, unbridled in lust

indicators.note: unbridled suggests letters let loose and running wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A stirring of unbridled lust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unbridled' rearranges IS ASTIR SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Satyriasis is excessive sexual desire in a man, named after the lustful satyrs.

clue.text: Greek character following old network on inner tubes

indicators.note: following means the Greek letter comes after the other pieces

parts.note: BR is British Rail, the former national railway network
chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek railway character rides an old network on inner tubes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inner tubes' looks like bicycle parts; it is the airways inside the lungs.
explanation.definitionFit: Bronchi are the main air passages branching into the lungs, tubes inside the body.

clue.text: Sunburst makes hooter hairy

indicators.note: burst means the letters of the word are broken up and scattered

parts.note: a horn is a hooter, as on a car

explanation.surface: A sunburst makes the car horn hairy.
explanation.walkthrough: The one word 'Sunburst' does two things: its first part is the fodder and 'burst' rearranges it into UNS, before the hooter.
explanation.definitionFit: Unshorn means not cut or shaved, so still hairy.
